cards.text: Some time after Ahab's battles with Aram, we're in Jezreel. A man named Naboth the Jezreelite owns a vineyard there. And that vineyard sits right next to the palace of Ahab, king of Samaria.

cards.question: King Ahab has his eye on the vineyard next door. What does he want to turn it into?
Ahab makes Naboth an offer for the vineyard. What is it?

answers.text: A better vineyard or its value in silver
A home inside the palace walls
A seat among the king's officials

cards.text: A KING just walked over with a deal, friend, and most of us would say yes before he finished talking. Not Naboth.

cards.question: Naboth tells King Ahab no. What reason does Naboth give?

answers.text: It's the inheritance of his fathers
The king's offer is far too low
He already promised it to his son

cards.text: So Ahab goes home to his palace sullen and angry. Friend, one 'no' from the neighbor and the king takes his ball and goes home.

cards.question: Back at the palace, Ahab lies down on his bed, turns his face away and refuses to ___.

cards.text: Then his wife Jezebel comes in and asks, 'Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?' Friend, a grown man with a CROWN, face to the wall, over a vegetable garden.

cards.question: Ahab tells Jezebel what Naboth said. True or false: Ahab mentions that the vineyard is the inheritance of Naboth's fathers.

cards.text: Jezebel isn't having it. She says, 'Do you not reign over Israel?' and tells him to get up, eat something and cheer up.

cards.question: Then Jezebel makes Ahab a promise. What is it?

answers.text: She will get him Naboth's vineyard
She will find him a better vineyard

cards.text: Then Jezebel writes letters in Ahab's name and seals them with his seal. That's somebody grabbing your phone and texting the whole group chat as YOU.

cards.question: Who does Jezebel send her letters to?

answers.text: The elders and nobles of Naboth's city
The priests of Baal in Samaria

cards.text: In the letters she writes: 'Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.' A seat of HONOR, friend? I don't trust it.

cards.question: Jezebel's letters say to seat two ___ across from Naboth.
Jezebel wants two men to testify against Naboth. What are they supposed to accuse him of?

answers.text: Cursing both God and the king

cards.question: Jezebel's letters arrive in Naboth's city. True or false: the elders and nobles do what the letters tell them.

cards.text: They proclaim the fast and give Naboth his seat of honor. Then the two scoundrels sit down across from him and testify in front of everyone: 'Naboth has cursed both God and the king!'

cards.question: Two scoundrels have just testified against Naboth in front of the people. What happens to Naboth?

answers.text: He's taken out and stoned to death

cards.text: Naboth is gone. The men of his city send word back to Jezebel: 'Naboth has been stoned to death.' And Jezebel goes to her husband.

cards.question: Jezebel tells Ahab that Naboth is dead. What does she tell Ahab to do?

answers.text: Go take possession of the vineyard

cards.question: The king who wouldn't get off his bed hears that Naboth is dead. True or false: Ahab gets up and goes down to take the vineyard.

cards.text: But the LORD sees all of it. The word of the LORD comes to Elijah the Tishbite, God's prophet, and tells him to go down and meet Ahab.

cards.question: Where does the LORD tell Elijah he'll find Ahab?

answers.text: On his bed in the palace

cards.text: The LORD gives Elijah a question to bring to Ahab: 'Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?'

cards.question: Then the LORD speaks about the place where the dogs licked up Naboth's blood. What does He say will happen there?

answers.text: Dogs will lick up Ahab's blood too
Ahab will build Naboth a tomb
Naboth's sons will take the land back

cards.text: Elijah shows up, and Ahab says, 'So you have found me out, my enemy.' Friend, that's getting caught with your hand in the cookie jar and calling the guy who caught you the villain.

cards.question: Elijah tells Ahab that yes, he has found him out. What reason does Elijah give?

answers.text: Ahab sold himself to do evil
Ahab broke his word to Naboth
Ahab hid from the LORD's prophets

cards.text: Then Elijah gives Ahab the LORD's words. Calamity is coming on Ahab, and every male in his line will be cut off.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll make Ahab's house like the houses of Jeroboam and Baasha, two earlier kings of Israel. Why?

answers.text: Ahab provoked His anger and caused Israel to sin
Ahab trusted his army instead of the LORD
Ahab refused to listen to the prophet Elijah

cards.question: The LORD has a word about Jezebel too: the dogs will devour her by the wall of ___.

cards.text: And anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs. Anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.

Then the writer steps in with a note: there was never one like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil, incited by his wife Jezebel. He went after idols, just like the Amorites the LORD had driven out before Israel.

cards.question: Ahab hears every word Elijah brought. Then he tears his ___ and puts on ___.

cards.text: He fasts, lies down in sackcloth and walks around meekly. Friend, this is the SAME man who just called Elijah his enemy!

cards.question: Then the word of the LORD comes to Elijah again. True or false: the LORD asks Elijah if he has seen how Ahab humbled himself.
Because Ahab humbled himself, what does the LORD say about the calamity?

answers.text: It will come in his son's days instead of his
It will never come on Ahab's house
It will fall on Jezebel alone

cards.text: And that's where we set this batch down to cool. Trust me, friend, this story is NOT over.
